name: blockwise-mac
description: Blockwise for the Mac: time blocks, tasks and a menu bar timer, synced with Nextcloud, Dropbox or Google Drive.

scripts.helper: mkdir -p helper/build && swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos13 -framework EventKit -o helper/build/blockwise-calendar helper/BlockwiseCalendar.swift
scripts.test: node scripts/sync-web.js && node test/alerts.test.js && node test/drives.test.js && node test/providers.test.js && node test/calmode.test.js && node test/login.test.js && node test/onedrive.test.js && node test/cloudmode.test.js
scripts.test:ui: node scripts/sync-web.js && node test/setup.test.js && node test/calendar.test.js && node test/start-ui.test.js && node test/app.test.js
scripts.build: node scripts/sync-web.js && npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dmg: node scripts/sync-web.js && npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dmg

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Blockwise opens Apple Calendar on the day you choose.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Blockwise shows your calendar's time blocks and adds the blocks you plan.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Blockwise shows your calendar's time blocks and adds the blocks you plan.
